name: stayon
description: Project tasks in TASKS.md, plus one useful thing to do while Claude works.

taskFile.title: Task file
taskFile.description: Path of the task file, relative to the project root. Empty: use TASKS.md, or .stayon/TASKS.md if only that exists.

suggestions.title: Suggest tasks while Claude works
suggestions.description: Show one of your ready tasks above the prompt while Claude is working.

suggestDelaySeconds.title: Suggestion delay (seconds)
suggestDelaySeconds.description: How long a turn must run before a suggestion appears, and before a ready cue is worth showing.

notifyAfterSeconds.title: Notify after (seconds)
notifyAfterSeconds.description: Send a desktop notification when a turn at least this long ends. 0 turns it off.

openOnStart.title: Open the pane on start
openOnStart.description: Open the StayOn pane when a session starts in a project that has a task file.
